entries.title: Praise that turns to revulsion
entries.literal_meaning: Extraordinary beauty; seeing you makes me feel like vomiting.
entries.explanation: The apparent praise turns sharply into rejection. The dictionary places the saying under figurative revulsion, separate from its physical sense. Our reading hears an insulting reversal, not a reliable description of someone’s appearance. A speaker’s disgust does not establish another person’s worth, and the line supplies no relationship or occasion.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଶଂସା ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଉଥିବା କଥା ହଠାତ୍ ଘୃଣାରେ ବଦଳିଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଶାରୀରିକ ବାନ୍ତି ନୁହେଁ, ଲକ୍ଷଣାର୍ଥରେ ଘୃଣାବୋଧ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏଠି ଅପମାନର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣେ, କାହାର ରୂପର ନିର୍ଭରଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ନୁହେଁ। ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ଘୃଣା କାହାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେନାହିଁ। ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବା ଅବସର ଅକୁହା।
entries.english_summary: Our reading questions praise used to deliver an insult.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ଆଢ଼ୁଆଳରେ ଅପମାନକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, କଥାର ଆରମ୍ଭ ଭଲ ଶୁଣାଗଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶେଷଟି କାହାକୁ କଷ୍ଟ ଦେଇପାରେ। / A reading group discusses how a flattering opening can become hurtful. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The earlier Krishna Singh Mahabharata example illustrates the physical sense; it does not supply this saying’s author. Irony is our reading of the contrast, not a medical or beauty judgment.

entries.title: Rice and the people who serve
entries.literal_meaning: If there is rice, are people serving for food hard to find?
entries.explanation: The question connects available food with the availability of a servant. The dictionary supplies both serving-for-food and servant senses. Our critical reading asks what is lost when a person’s labour is reduced to a meal. The wording does not establish that workers are plentiful everywhere, that food is adequate payment, or that anyone owes service for being fed.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ଭାତ ଥିବା ସହ ସେବା କରିବା ଲୋକ ମିଳିବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ନ ପାଇଁ ସେବା କରୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଓ ଚାକର ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ: ଜଣଙ୍କ ଶ୍ରମକୁ କେବଳ ଭୋଜନରେ ମାପିଲେ କଣ ଅଦେଖା ରହେ? ସବୁଠି କର୍ମୀ ସହଜରେ ମିଳନ୍ତି, ଭୋଜନ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ପାରିଶ୍ରମିକ, କିମ୍ବା ଖାଇଥିବାରୁ ସେବା ଦେବାକୁ ହେବ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଏସବୁର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our response distinguishes feeding someone from valuing their work.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଖାଇବାକୁ ଦେବା ଓ ଶ୍ରମର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦେବାକୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ଆୟୋଜନରେ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ହେବା ପରେ ଦଳଟି କର୍ମୀଙ୍କ କାମ, ସମୟ ଓ ପାରିଶ୍ରମିକ ନେଇ ଅଲଗା ଆଲୋଚନା କଲା। / Organizers discuss workers’ time and pay separately from catering. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: This critical response is editorial, not a traditional counter-moral. The source question provides no verified employment custom, universal worker trait or justification of servitude.
